name: Nav Pill
description: A pill of links that floats at the top of the page, steps away while you scroll down and returns when you scroll up.

props.name: items
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; current?: boolean }[]
props.description: The links. The current one gets aria-current="page" and a water dot. Below 640 pixels, items with an icon show only the icon and keep the name for screen readers.

props.name: action
props.description: One small button or link at the right end, after a hairline.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Scroll distance in pixels before scrolling down hides the bar. Above it the bar always shows.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the fixed nav element that holds the pill. Also accepts every other nav attribute.
